highlight.label: cut from a tax estimation service's response times

results: Redesigned the Canadian online product's navigation around a central hub that shows filers their progress and best next step.

Expanded automatic import of US tax forms, reducing manual entry and improving accuracy.

projects.title: Real-time trading desktop platform
projects.summary: A high-performance desktop platform that gives rates traders live financial data in customizable, tabbed workspaces.

highlight.label: developer wait time, down from about 30 seconds

results: Built the desktop foundation that hosts modular trading apps, remembers each user's windows and layouts, and lets apps communicate with each other.
Improved speed and reliability by tuning live data updates, restoring complex saved layouts more dependably and removing rendering bottlenecks.
Reduced startup time by loading features on demand.
Cut developer wait times from about 30 seconds to 2–3 seconds by letting engineers run individual apps locally.
Upgraded core frameworks across the platform to close security vulnerabilities, and built shared component libraries that keep teams consistent.
